Today's selection covers 96 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Bad Memories Still Haunt AI Agents
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New Phishing Scam: Fake Invitations
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
